leaders.h2: Built by people who lived the problem.
leaders.people[0].bio:
IIT Delhi. First Product Manager at Zupee, one of India's largest real-money gaming platforms, where he built and scaled the product function before founding Shruhani. Leads strategy, institutional partnerships, and go-to-market.
The founding thesis came from firsthand experience: Indian financial institutions were making high-stakes decisions on incomplete data, and no one was building the intelligence layer to fix it.
leaders.people[0].name: Arvinder Singla
leaders.people[1].bio:
NIT Kurukshetra (B.Tech, Information Technology). Over a decade in machine learning and data science across Flipkart (ML Engineering), Goldman Sachs (Data Science), and Zupee (Data Science).
At Shruhani, Amit built the intelligence architecture from the ground up: six signal modules, the scoring models, the portfolio calibration pipeline, and the graph-based community detection engine. Every model in production traces back to his team.

story.h2:
Born from a problem
no one had solved.
story.paragraphs:
Before Shruhani, Arvinder and Amit were building Zupee, one of India's largest real-money gaming platforms. Every transaction on the platform carried fraud risk. Every user's identity had to be verified in real time, at scale.
They went looking for a solution. What they found was a market full of point tools: one vendor for device checks, another for identity, a third for rules. Nothing connected the dots across device, behaviour, identity, and location into a single customer picture.
story.paragraphsAfter: What started as an internal solution became clear as a market-wide gap. Every Indian bank, NBFC, and lender was making high-stakes customer decisions on incomplete data. Shruhani was founded in 2022 to close that gap.
story.quote: They could not find the product. So they built it.
